title: Why it sucks being the captain

scenes.text: Why it sucks being the captain.
It starts when you're eight. The coach gives you the armband. You think it's an honour. It means you do the coin toss... and lose it.
Age eleven. You're losing 5-0. The coach says: "Captain, say something." Everyone stares at you.
Age thirteen. Your teammate screams at the referee. The referee: "Captain! Come here." You get the yellow card.
Age fifteen. Final whistle. Everyone goes home. You collect the bibs. The cones. The balls. Alone.
Age sixteen. Penalty shootout. Nobody wants the fifth one. Everyone looks at the armband.
Age seventeen. You win the cup! You lift the trophy for one second... then the striker takes it for the photo.
That's the thing about being the captain. When you win, it's the team.
Tag your captain. Tell them: we've got you.
